engine: mixed OPM Flow and analytical screening ensembles

reservoirs.name: Gassum Formation
reservoirs.ensemble_design: L9 property ensemble for each all-fault state and Alpha/Beta/Zeta unit response

fault_scenarios.orientation: all supplied traces represented vertically through all six Gassum layers
fault_scenarios.response_method: unit-rate OPM responses superposed for 1, 2 and 3 Mt/yr screening

limitations: Gassum is an OPM Flow screening ensemble, not a history-matched or permitting model.
Other formations remain analytical screening proxies until their OPM grids are populated.
Fault thresholds and geomechanical coupling are illustrative until calibrated data are supplied.
